title: Action required: invoice 2026-03-07 failed — portal link + VAT update
text:
Action required: invoice 2026-03-07 failed — portal link + VAT update

['From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Price <emma.price@greenarcanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Action required: invoice 2026-03-07 failed — portal link + VAT update

Hi Emma,

Hope you’re well. Quick note that our attempt to charge card on file for invoice 2026-03-07 (amount: $12,450.00) failed earlier today — Stripe returned a card_declined / card_not_supported error. That usually means the token on file needs a refresh or the bank is rejecting the merchant type.

Two things we can do right away:
- I can send a secure hosted payment link so you can update the card without sharing details by email.
- If you need the invoice to include your UK VAT number, reply with the VAT ID and we’ll reissue an invoice with the VAT line.

If you prefer, I can pause automated dunning for 72 hours while you update payment. Please let me know which option you prefer.

Attaching the original invoice for reference: invoice_20260307_greenarc_v1.pdf (PDF).

Thanks — looking forward to your reply so we can avoid a retry/collection.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Attach: invoice_20260307_greenarc_v1.pdf
', 'From: Emma Price <emma.price@greenarcanalytics.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 10:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Action required: invoice 2026-03-07 failed — portal link + VAT update

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for flagging. I tried to update the card via our customer portal earlier this morning but hit an error — the token refresh failed and the portal returned a generic payment error. I don’t want to put card details in email.

Please reissue the invoice with our UK VAT number: GB123456789 and send a hosted/update link that our finance team can use to provide the new card. Can you also include the company address for billing?

Billing address: GreenArc Analytics Ltd.
10 Birch Street
London EC1A 1AA
United Kingdom

Appreciate the pause on dunning — that would be helpful while we sort the update.

Best,
Emma
Emma Price
Head of Finance | GreenArc Analytics
emma.price@greenarcanalytics.com
', 'From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Action required: invoice 2026-03-07 failed — portal link + VAT update

Stephanie / Laura — quick internal note after checking Stripe:
- Payment attempt at 09:01 UTC returned decline code card_not_supported (likely 3DS or card type restriction).
- Token on file is from an old Checkout session; refresh required.

Recommended steps:
1) Issue a hosted payment update link (Stripe Billing customer portal or one-click hosted-update). Use ephemeral session so they don’t re-enter the invoice numbers.
2) Reissue invoice to include VAT GB123456789 and billing address Laura provided (see Emma’s message). Mark previous invoice as superseded (do not collect while pending).
3) Pause dunning for this invoice for 72 hours to avoid automated collection attempts. We should log an internal note on the HubSpot deal: DEAL-7892.

Laura — can you reissue the invoice (v2) and drop it to Emma? I’ll generate the hosted-update link.

Ben
Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
', 'From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Price <emma.price@greenarcanalytics.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action required: invoice 2026-03-07 failed — portal link + VAT update

Hi Emma — thanks for the VAT number and address.

I’ve reissued the invoice as requested: invoice_20260312_greenarc_v2_UKVAT.pdf (attached) — it includes your VAT number and the billing address you provided.

Stephanie / Ben — I’ve set the invoice status to Pending (superseded) in Stripe and added a 72-hour hold on automated retries. HubSpot note: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7892 (internal).

Emma — here’s the secure hosted payment update link to refresh the card token: https://payments.redwood.ai/hosted-update/ghY7k2 (expires in 24 hours). Once you update the card the gateway will attempt the charge immediately.

Attach: invoice_20260312_greenarc_v2_UKVAT.pdf

If anything goes sideways ping me and I’ll escalate.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Billing Specialist | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
', 'From: Emma Price <emma.price@greenarcanalytics.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Action required: invoice 2026-03-07 failed — portal link + VAT update

Hi all,

Confirmed — I used the hosted link and updated the card. I can see the payment as successful on our side. Please let me know if you see the capture go through.

Thanks for the quick help and for reissuing the VAT invoice.

Best,
Emma
